# stb_image

`stb_image.h` v2.30 from https://github.com/nothings/stb, commit
`f58f558c120e9b32c217290b80bad1a0729fbb2c`, unmodified. Public domain (or MIT,
your choice) - the licence text is at the end of the header.

Used by `port/stage/plate.c` to decode graphics-override PNGs
(`overrides/<pack>/gfx/...`), PNG only (`STBI_ONLY_PNG`).
